milestones.title: Runtime and integration assessment
milestones.summary: The assessment selected GitHub Actions with pinned DeepSeek Harness for the tested configuration.
limitations: Boundary and cancellation coverage remained partial.
The diagnosis rubric was visible to the candidate.
The assessment does not establish production readiness.

milestones.title: Synthetic pipeline
milestones.summary: The synthetic pipeline gate was accepted and closed.
limitations: Acceptance applies to its recorded synthetic scope.

milestones.title: Live-agent engineering
milestones.summary: The phase closed under an explicit owner exception.
limitations: The exception does not establish successful completion of the original live protocol.
Full runtime qualification was not accepted.

milestones.title: Issue to verified draft PR
milestones.summary: A deterministic change reached an open draft PR with the exact verified candidate through an owner-started retained-candidate continuation.
limitations: No Phase 2 model call or live AI coding proof.
Automatic issue forwarding and one uninterrupted issue-to-PR execution were not demonstrated.
No merge, deployment, production remediation, or general runtime qualification was demonstrated.
The original publisher failure cause remains unknown.

milestones.title: CI diagnosis and repair
milestones.summary: A local implementation proposal is prepared. Hosted proof and acceptance are pending.
limitations: Local or simulated results do not establish hosted acceptance.

milestones.title: Alert investigation and approvals
milestones.summary: Plan read-only alert investigation and separate approvals for implementation and publication.
limitations: No alert integration or approval flow is claimed as demonstrated.

milestones.title: Same-runtime Factory evaluation
milestones.summary: Plan an exploratory comparison using the same runtime and approved fixtures.

milestones.title: Optional second runtime
milestones.summary: Optionally evaluate a second runtime under shared task and acceptance contracts.
limitations: This phase is optional and has not started.

milestones.title: Limited pilot and automatic recovery
milestones.summary: Qualify recovery, retention, access, reconciliation, and operations before a limited pilot.
